🚀 Agent Payments Protocol (AP2): How AI Agents Can Pay With Proof of Consent

AI agents can shop, but paying is harder when no human is at checkout. The Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) uses cryptographically signed mandates to prove what a user authorized, giving merchants, wallets, and issuers verifiable consent. Here is how it works and where it fits.

Read more: https://zyvop.com/agent-payments-protocol-ap2-how-ai-agents-can-pay-with-proof-of-consent-golh0?utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=crosspost
